facts.text: Deborah mentions that the roses and dahlias in the garden bring her peace.

evidence.quote: The roses and dahlias bring me peace.

facts.text: Deborah states that she lost a friend last week and has been spending time in the garden to find comfort.

evidence.quote: I lost a friend last week, so I've been spending time in the garden to find some comfort.

facts.text: Deborah says that memories of time spent with her friend Karlie remind her of how special life is.

evidence.quote: It reminds me of how special life is.
This is the last photo with Karlie which was taken last summer when we hiked. It was our last one. We had such a great time!
